chapter: After the Army: JATP, clubs and first Europe trips
title: Touring with Mezzrow in 1953
summary: In 1953 he returned for Mezzrow with Big Chief Moore, Taps Miller and Lindy Hop dancers, bringing his wife.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Yes. Sedric Sedrick, Gene Sedrick, myself, Kansas Fields, Taps Miller. Taps
And dancing. And we had two teams from the Savoy Ballroom that was doing the Lindy Hop. So that was a nice trip too. That was a very nice, and I took my wife on that one. I took my wife. It was nice.
